spans.s:
--a ceremonial of the श्राद्ध; the mode of offering three to पितृस्, पितामहस् and प्रपितामहस् with the respective मन्त्रस् to be uttered at that time;
1: Br. III. ११. १९. ५८, ९७; वा. ७४. १७; ७५. ४१; ७६. ३१-5; Vi. III. १५. ३४.
पिण्डम् may also be offered to fire, cows, crows, fowls, with their respective effects to the giver.
2: वा. १२०. ३१-41.
(I)--a son of Vasudeva and रोहिणी. Br. III. ७१. १६५; M. ४६. १२; वा. ९६. १६३.

(II)--a तीर्थ sacred to धृति;
1: M. १३. ४८.
sacred to पितृस्;
2: Ib. २२. ६९.
Here the sages cursed the extinction of the Yadu family, when the यादव youths played a joke on them by dressing up साम्ब as a woman and asking them to say what child he would bring forth.
3: Vi. V. ३७. 6-१०.
[page२-328+ ३६]
--of an image, to be purified with पञ्चगव्य. M. २६६. 6.
--the fruit of ingudi tree offered with ghee as पिण्ड (see रामा. Ayo. १०२. २९: १०५. ३५). वा. १६. १४.
